title: Austria: EDM registration and collection-system participation
summary: A business placing packaging on the Austrian market must register in the EDM portal (edm.gv.at) and contract with a licensed collection and recovery system such as ARA, then report packaging volumes and materials.

sources.title: Primärverpflichtete von Verpackungen (Unternehmensserviceportal, usp.gv.at)
sources.note: Fetched directly. § 13g(1) AWG 2002 defines 'Primärverpflichtete' as, among others, importers with an AT seat, packers with an AT seat, and -- the category that matters for a non-established e-commerce seller -- distance sellers with NO Austrian seat/establishment who deliver packaging or packaged goods to a private end consumer in Austria via distance selling. That last limb is what keeps this row's applies_when correctly broad (no organisation.established_in_market condition needed): the EDM/collection-system duty attaches regardless of AT establishment, as long as the sale reaches an Austrian end consumer. This mirrors the at.epr.authorised-representative row in this same batch, which additionally requires appointing an AT-based representative to carry out this very duty when the seller has no AT presence.

sources.title: EDM — Elektronisches Datenmanagement (Umweltbundesamt)
sources.note: Portal confirmed as the correct registration channel; the underlying legal duty is § 13g(1) AWG 2002 (see the usp.gv.at source above), not a citation of its own.
